Correctness verdict: `approve`. Independent core-fit verdict: approve. I could not break the reviewed behavior at `4008f4984ad0e6fc26d7fd1c1e3d6ca28673cc41`; all 106 selected test-method executions passed on each Python version, with zero skips. No human decision is requested by this review.

Reviewer: `final_correctness`, independent of claimant `codex`. Reviewed clone: `/private/tmp/agentfold-final-review-upper-r4`. Lower base: `5a9f044f84fbcc21597f7bf44466cab9b3694b42`. The review used the mechanical criteria/request/plan and code/guidance delta, the pinned code, and my own preserved probes. No worker report, progress narrative, or another reviewer's verdict supplied evidence. Earlier reports and probes remain unchanged.

The current delta protects complete triple-quoted literals and aligns source-boundary classifications across the two supported Unicode databases. My independent Unicode 16 enumeration contains 145,620 identifier-continuation characters and 760 decimal digits. The effective classification and decimal regex match those sets on Python 3.14 and Python 3.9, without treating newly assigned visible symbols as identifier continuations. These counts describe checked character sets, not test-method counts.

Twelve additional filled-template probes challenge embedded quotes/apostrophes inside triple literals, whitespace and omission changes within those literals, literal prefixes and escapes, new decimal digits, new letters, and new visible-symbol boundaries. Each negative probe required the real advisory finding, and each positive probe required no evidence or explanation finding. All pass. All 43 unchanged independent cases from my earlier rounds also pass, including token truncation, Unicode combining marks, prose apostrophes, and inline-code spacing.

The broader selected repository checks cover captured source bytes despite unstaged file/symlink changes; missing, escaping, nonregular and binary sources; line/heading selection; quotation and omission fidelity; external/no-source handling; and the full unanswerable-review succession conditions. All 48 selected methods ran and passed per interpreter. The source-evidence fixture helper additionally runs queue schema, attention, fold and rendering checks before comparing evidence.

The new [probe script](/private/tmp/final-correctness-upper-r4-probes.py) and [Unicode oracle](/private/tmp/final-correctness-upper-r4-unicode16.json) are separate from all prior evidence. The oracle was generated from Python 3.14's Unicode 16 standard-library database, independently of the implementation's supplement tables.

Commands ran from `/private/tmp/final-correctness-upper-r4-run` on Darwin arm64. `python3 --version` reported Python 3.14.6 and `/usr/bin/python3 --version` reported Python 3.9.6.
